claim: switch-to-configuration-ng contains a post-activation second pass that restarts or starts user units migrating from a per-user manager (home-manager) to NixOS /etc ownership, and before PR #517768 it did so unconditionally, ignoring X-ReloadIfChanged/reloadIfChanged opt-outs.
stance_target: gap-03: that switch never restarts user units
scope_conditions: units whose FragmentPath is outside /etc and which the new generation defines in /etc/systemd/user (home-manager shadowing or package-shipped units)
quoted_support: The post-activation pass added in 5cc82c4 to handle units migrating from a per-user manager (home-manager) to NixOS unconditionally restarts or starts any candidate. dbus-broker.service explicitly opts out of restarts via reloadIfChanged because restarting the session bus kills running clients; the second pass ignored that and restarted it anyway.

claim: PR #517768 (merged 2026-05-26 as 907350b, backported to release-26.05/staging-26.05/staging-nixos-26.05) made the migration pass honour X-ReloadIfChanged, X-RestartIfChanged, RefuseManualStop, RefuseManualStart and X-OnlyManualStart, and reworked candidate selection to: active unit + new generation defines it in /etc/systemd/user + (FragmentPath under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/systemd/user OR anywhere outside /etc not previously in /etc).
stance_target: gap-03: currency of the 2023-era claim on 2026 NixOS — the restart pass is now directive-aware, not absent
quoted_support: A unit is a migration candidate iff it is active, the new generation defines it in /etc/systemd/user, and either its FragmentPath is under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/systemd/user (the home-manager case) ... or its FragmentPath is anywhere else outside /etc and the previous generation did not have it in /etc

claim: nixos-activation.service (user scope) is explicitly restarted by stc-ng on every switch; commit 663a59e set RemainAfterExit=yes and restartIfChanged=false so it runs exactly once per switch, with a test asserting it is never killed or re-run.
stance_target: gap-03 sub-claim (Oct 2025 ElvishJerricco) that 'switch only restarts nixos-activation.service for users that are currently logged in' — the mechanism now covers all live user managers and restarts more than just activation
quoted_support: Set RemainAfterExit=yes so target starts are a no-op for an already-run activation, and restartIfChanged=false so the unit-diff pass leaves it alone when the script changes. The explicit restart in stc-ng remains the single trigger per switch.
